notes: Phone Optimizer v2.2 REDMI-STYLE AUTO-CLEAN: ek baar setup (Usage + All Files + Accessibility) ke baad app kholte hi khud auto-clean shuru — bina OPTIMIZE dabaye (6 ghante me max 1 baar). OPTIMIZE ab Accessibility off ho to bekaar run nahi karta, pehle wahi on karwata hai. Samsung fix: auto-tap timeout 6s se 10s (One UI slow hai), Clear cache button contentDescription se bhi pehchana jata hai. Honest limit: Redmi ka cleaner system app tha, isliye silent clear kar sakta tha — koi third-party app root ke bina silent clear nahi kar sakti; ye uske sabse kareeb automatic tareeka hai. Same release key, purani version ke upar install hoga.
